boards.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Image 1 is the GGB screen to revise. Images 2 and 3 are ONLY references for dialogue presentation from the user's supplied visual novel screenshots. Preserve Image 1's large left anime character appearance and pose, upper-left menu/current location, bottom-left notebook, right vertical five-item inventory, background composition and camera. Replace ONLY the dialogue presentation. REMOVE the solid rectangular dialogue box, straight brass box border and enclosed buttons. Instead create a full-width soft black bottom gradient across the lower 30% of the play area with richly engraved black gothic foliage/feather tracery at the lower corners, tapering into transparent darkness at the top, inspired by reference 2/3. Do not copy reference characters, names, text or logos. The text must float clearly on this atmospheric dark layer, never enclosed in a rectangular card. On the upper edge of the text area, starting to the RIGHT of the left character's silhouette, add a restrained dark diamond-shaped name ornament and a thin horizontal rule, with the exact name placeholder '대화 상대' in large elegant Korean lettering; name slightly more decorative, body a clear legible Korean serif or sans with no distressed texture. Body below in ivory, large readable two lines: '이 종이는 어디에서 찾았나요?' and '위쪽에 작은 홈이 있네요.' Darken the lower body behind lettering enough to prevent visual collision, but never cover the face. Add a small diamond continue marker at lower right of the dialogue text and a small readable '다음 Enter'. At the bottom beneath the text place discreet text control '대화 기록 H'. Keep notebook '수첩 N' at extreme bottom-left unchanged and above the ornamental layer, with a separate small toggle '자동 끔' just to its RIGHT; they must not overlap. Right inventory must remain at the EXACT same edge/position with same five items, but visibly dimmer in dialogue and caption '대화 중'; do not shift, hide or replace it. Upper-left '메뉴 Esc' and '현관 홀' remain sharp. No 'Skip' control, no combat UI. The result should feel like an atmospheric visual novel scene rather than a web modal, while following the user's GGB HUD anchors.
